correctness.rationale: In the separated affine similarity model, the finite-alphabet dimension s_N is the unique root a^{q s_N} sum_{j<=N} j^{-q s_N}=1. At s=1/q sign is exactly sign(a H_N-1). The strict integer crossing has log N_*=1/a-gamma+o(1), and zeta(1+epsilon)=epsilon^{-1}+gamma+O(epsilon) yields the stated exp(1/(lambda epsilon))(lambda epsilon)^{1/lambda} prefactor. Write e=q s-1 and expand log pressure: log P(0)=a t+o(a), first derivative=-1/(2a)+O(log(1/a)), variance O(a^{-2}) in e=O(a^2), hence e/a^2->2t uniformly on bounded t. Unshifted cutoff has t=(log(1/epsilon))/lambda+O(1), still a*t->0, giving 2lambda epsilon^2 log(1/epsilon). Exact harmonic/pressure and mpmath high-precision tests at lambda=.4,.6, epsilon=.02,.03 and t=±1 agree with sign and scaling; finite numerics do not prove limits.
